title: ANTS CreateTiledMosaic

alpha_value.desc: If an Rgb image is provided, render the overlay using the specified alpha parameter.

direction.desc: Specifies the direction of the slices. If no direction is specified, the direction with the coarsest spacing is chosen.

input_image.desc: Main input is a 3-D grayscale image.

mask_image.desc: Specifies the ROI of the RGB voxels used.

output_image.desc: The output consists of the tiled mosaic image.

pad_or_crop.desc: argument passed to -p flag:[padVoxelWidth,<constantValue=0>][lowerPadding[0]xlowerPadding[1],upperPadding[0]xupperPadding[1],constantValue]The user can specify whether to pad or crop a specified voxel-width boundary of each individual slice. For this program, cropping is simply padding with negative voxel-widths.If one pads (+), the user can also specify a constant pad value (default = 0). If a mask is specified, the user can use the mask to define the region, by using the keyword "mask" plus an offset, e.g. "-p mask+3".

rgb_image.desc: An optional Rgb image can be added as an overlay.It must have the same imagegeometry as the input grayscale image.

tile_geometry.desc: The tile geometry specifies the number of rows and columnsin the output image. For example, if the user specifies "5x10", then 5 rows by 10 columns of slices are rendered. If R < 0 and C > 0 (or vice versa), the negative value is selectedbased on direction.

description: The program CreateTiledMosaic in conjunction with ConvertScalarImageToRGB
